title: UI/UX Designer Intern — Web & Mobile Applications
description:
**UI/UX Designer Intern — Web & Mobile Applications**

**Company:** Fawrit Technologies India Private Limited**Location:** Kochi**Work Mode:** Work from Office**Internship Type:** Full-time Internship

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **UI/UX Designer Intern** to help design user-friendly and visually appealing web and mobile applications. You will work closely with product managers and developers to understand user requirements and convert ideas into practical, intuitive designs.

This role is suitable for someone who understands basic UI/UX principles, is comfortable using Figma, and wants hands-on experience designing real digital products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design user interfaces for web applications, responsive websites, and mobile apps.
* Create user flows, wireframes, mock-ups, and interactive prototypes.
* Improve the usability and visual consistency of existing product screens.
* Conduct basic user research and study competitor applications.
* Build and maintain reusable components and design systems in Figma.
* Design responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are implemented correctly.
* Review developed screens and identify UI inconsistencies or usability issues.
* Organise design files, components, styles, and documentation properly.
* Incorporate feedback from users, developers, and product stakeholders.

**Skills Required**

* Working knowledge of **Figma**.
* Understanding of UI design, UX principles, typography, spacing, colour, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and responsive designs.
* Understanding of web and mobile application design patterns.
* Basic knowledge of design systems and reusable components.
* Good communication, creativity, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to accept feedback and improve designs through multiple iterations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Students or recent graduates in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Computer Science, or a related field.
* A portfolio containing web, mobile app, academic, freelance, or personal design projects.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, React, or frontend development is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with usability testing, accessibility, and developer handoff is an advantage.

**What You Will Gain**

* Hands-on experience designing real web and mobile applications.
* Experience working directly with product and software development teams.
* Practical exposure to wireframing, prototyping, design systems, responsive design, and developer handoff.
* Portfolio-worthy work, subject to confidentiality and company approval.
* Internship Completion Certificate based on satisfactory attendance and completion of assigned work.
* Letter of Recommendation for interns who demonstrate strong performance, professionalism, and commitment.
* High-performing interns may be considered for full-time opportunities, subject to performance, business requirements, and available openings.

**Application Requirement**

Applicants should submit their resume along with a portfolio or links to relevant Figma, Behance, Dribbble, academic, freelance, or personal design projects.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Mobile Platform Engineer
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: 1 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1745063

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Role name and description**

**Mobile Platform Engineer**

Join EY as a Mobile Platform Engineer and be at the forefront of designing and implementing innovative mobile solutions that enhance our services and drive efficiency. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our mobile environment, working autonomously while collaborating closely with key stakeholders across the globe.

  

**The opportunity**

As a Mobile Platform Engineer, you will play a crucial for the Mobile services at EY. By designing, testing, and implementing new mobile products and services within our Intune-based mobile environment, you will contribute to creating and maintaining a seamless experiences for our Mobile users. With over 400,000 users and 350,000 enrolled devices, your expertise will help ensure that our mobile solutions are not only innovative but also secure and aligned with our strategic goals.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Design, test and implementation of new mobile products and services, ensuring they meet quality and security standards.
* Proactively suggest new ideas and solutions, driving them to implementation with minimal guidance on technical delivery.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Manager and Technical Lead to align on project goals and execution.
* Provide input to the Mobile Roadmap and actively participate in bringing it to life.
* Manage Intune policies and configurations to maintain a secure mobile platform.
* Serve as the last level of support, troubleshooting and resolving issues that exceed the capabilities of the support organization.
* Work with colleagues and customers all over the globe, ensuring effective communication and collaboration across different time zones.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Analytical Ability: Strong analytical skills in supported core technologies, particularly in managing large user bases, to effectively design, test, implement, troubleshoot and optimize mobile solutions.
* Creative Problem-Solving: Ability to conceptualize innovative solutions that add value to end users, particularly in the context of mobile applications and services.
* Self-Starter Mentality: A proactive and self-motivated approach to work, with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward independently.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in English is required.
* Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and tact to foster collaboration with colleagues and customers across diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Documentation Skills: Clear and concise documentation skills, ensuring that all processes, solutions, and communications are well-documented for future reference.
* Vendor Management: Ability to manage strategic vendors, such as Microsoft, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and effective service delivery.
* Cross-Cultural Awareness: Awareness of and sensitivity to cross-cultural dynamics, enabling effective collaboration with global teams and clients.
* Training and Knowledge Sharing: Willingness to share knowledge and provide training, both virtually and hands-on, to empower team members and enhance overall team capability.
* User Experience Focus: Passionate about improving user experience, with an understanding of how to measure, monitor, and enhance user satisfaction through feedback and analytics.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Five or more years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune, Entra, Entra conditional access, Mobile Device and Application Management with a thorough understanding of its design and architecture.
* Proven experience in mobile platform engineering or a related field.
* Solution oriented mindset with the capability to design and implement creative Mobile solutions and the ability to suggest and implement solutions that meet EY’s requirements
* Strong understanding of mobile technologies and security protocols, particularly within an Intune-based environment.
* Experience with iOS and Android operating systems.
* Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and management tasks.
* Ability to operate proactively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with the latest trends in mobile technology.
* Ability to work UK working hours

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with various stakeholders.
* A proactive approach to suggesting and implementing new ideas.
* Ability to explain very technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience in managing and supporting large mobile environments.
* Testing and Quality Assurance – ensure our mobile platform meets quality, performance and security standards.
* Implementation of new products and/or service offerings.
* Experience with working in a large global environment

  

**What we look for**

We are looking for people who are skilled in their work, can find solutions to technical challenges, and also love to be creative and do their best. The best candidates are those who work well with others, want to learn new things, and are committed to helping our clients and making a difference.

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:**You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you****:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership****:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:**You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Technical Support – III (Mobile Application Development), ICMR-Funded Project
description:
Applications are invited for the position of Project Staff for an ICMR\-funded project under Health Science Research (HSR), Kochi Campus. The project titled A Cluster\-Randomized Trial of Early Follow\-Up, Parenting Support Program, and Mobile Application on Growth Trajectories, Neurodevelopment, and Metabolic Risks among Small for Gestational Age Infants, Central Kerala (Project ID: EM/DEV/IG/2026/1608\) .
  
How to Apply
  
  

Candidates who meet the essential qualifications may submit their applications through the online application link on or before 2nd October 2026
  
  

Interested candidates are requested to send their updated resume / CV to hsr@aims.amrita.edu
  
  

Please mention the position applied for in the subject line of your email and also the project title.
  
  

**Place of Work :** Amrita Institute of Medical Science (AIMS), Kochi
  
  

Name of the Post
  
Project Technical Support – III (Mobile Application Development)
  
  

Location
  
Ernakulam, Keralam
  
  

Duration
  
Up to 2 years (initial tenure of 11 months, extendable based on performance)
  
  

Remuneration
  
As per project/ICMR norms
  
  

Requirements
  
1
  
  

Qualifications
  
MCA
  
  

Job Description
  
  

Design, develop, and maintain the project's mobile application for tracking growth trajectories, neurodevelopment, and metabolic risks among Small for Gestational Age (SGA) infants.
  
  

Integrate the mobile application with the parenting support program modules and early follow\-up schedules.
  
  

Ensure the application is user\-friendly for parents/caregivers and field health workers, with support for Malayalam language interface.
  
  

Implement data capture, storage, and synchronization features for field data collection.
  
  

Coordinate with the research team to align app features with the study protocol and data collection tools.
  
  

Provide technical support and troubleshooting for app users during field implementation.
  
  

Assist with data management, backup, and security of app\-generated data.
  
  

Travel to field sites within Central Kerala for app deployment, training, and user support.
  
  

Assist with documentation, report writing, and technical manuals for the mobile application.
  
  

Desirable Skills
  
  

Experience in Android and/or iOS application development.
  
  

Experience with backend integration.
  
  

Knowledge of data security and privacy protocols for health data.
  
  

Familiarity with mobile data collection platforms.
  
  

Proficiency in Malayalam (preferred for field coordination and user training).
  
  

Strong MS Excel and basic data management skills
  
  

Last Date to Apply
  
October 2, 2026

title: Mobile Developer
description:
**Associate – Software Engineering (Mobile)**

**Job Summary:**

Job Title: Associate – Software Engineering (Mobile)  
Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, India  
Job Type: Full\-time, Permanent  
Experience: 1\-2 years preferred  
Department: Engineering  
Reporting To: Lead \- Software Engineering (Mobile )  
Preference: Immediate joiners preferred

**About Eloit**

Eloit Innovations is a London\-headquartered global SaaS and software product company with strong engineering operations in Kochi, India. Eloit is on a mission of unlocking potential through graceful innovation.

Our platforms include Edisapp School ERP and LMS, Credisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, and other growing technology products serving schools, institutions, and faith communities across the globe.

**The Role**

We are hiring an Associate – Software Engineering (Mobile) to contribute to Eloit’s Mobile Engineering efforts across Edisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, Credisapp, and future products.

This is an Associate role at Eloit, reporting directly to the Lead \- Software Engineering (Mobile). The role involves developing, enhancing, testing, and maintaining mobile applications, collaborating with development and business teams, and contributing to the delivery of reliable and high\-quality mobile solutions.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in mobile application development, good problem\-solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to learning new technologies and improving application performance and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain mobile applications across Eloit products, including Edisapp, Kristapp, BibleOn, Credisapp, and future mobile applications.
* Contribute to mobile application development using Flutter and Dart, following established coding standards and development practices.
* Assist in developing scalable, reusable, and modular mobile application components for Android and iOS platforms.
* Build and maintain reusable UI components, shared utilities, and common functionalities across mobile applications.
* Integrate mobile applications with APIs and backend services, ensuring proper data handling and reliable application functionality.
* Work with state management, local storage, caching, and other mobile development practices under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs, performance issues, and application crashes to improve mobile application stability and user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and implement feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and development practices.
* Support Android and iOS application releases, including build preparation, testing, version updates, release notes, and app store submissions.
* Follow established security, privacy, and compliance practices while developing mobile applications, particularly for products handling student, parent, school, parish, and faith\-community data.
* Monitor and investigate production issues and provide timely fixes under the guidance of senior team members.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, UI/UX, Customer Experience, Implementation, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver reliable and user\-friendly mobile applications.
* Stay updated with Flutter, Dart, Android, iOS, and related mobile development technologies, and continuously improve technical skills.
* Follow established engineering practices for version control, documentation, testing, debugging, and application performance**.**

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–2 years of experience in mobile application development, preferably in a service\-based or product development environment.
* **Mobile Development Expertise:** Strong hands\-on experience with Flutter and Dart for developing mobile applications.
* **API Integration:** Experience in integrating REST APIs, handling JSON data, authentication, and working with backend services.
* **State Management:** Working knowledge of state management approaches such as Bloc, Provider, Riverpod, GetX, or similar frameworks.
* **UI \& Code Quality:** Ability to develop reusable UI components and write clean, maintainable, and well\-structured code following established development standards.
* **Debugging \& Performance:** Good understanding of debugging, error handling, application performance, and resolving functional and technical issues.
* **Version Control \& Development Tools:** Experience with Git and familiarity with standard development workflows and collaboration practices.
* **Build \& Release:** Basic understanding of Android and iOS build, testing, and release processes is an added advantage.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Collaboration**: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, good communication, and a willingness to learn and work collaboratively with cross\-functional team.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Day Shift
* Opportunity to work on Mobile engineering for globally used SaaS products
* Values\-driven and mission\-oriented work culture

**What will you do at Eloit?**

* Work on meaningful products used by educational institutions and users across different regions.
* Collaborate with product, design, engineering and QA teams in an agile environment.
* Contribute ideas that improve usability, performance, reliability and scalability.
* Take ownership of features from requirement analysis through development, testing and release.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates may send their resume and cover letter explaining their suitability for this role to:

Email: jobs@eloit.com

Subject Line: Associate – Software Engineering (Mobile)

Website: www.eloit.com

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Last Drawn Monthly CTC?
* What is the Notice Period?

Experience:

* Mobile Developer: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person
